title: Prehabilitation prior to oncological resection for stage I-III pancreatic ductal andenocarcinoma, esophageal and gastric cancer – a prospective feasibility study
summary: As part of this study, we would like to find out how pre-treatment (prehabilitation) of patients with pancreatic, oesophageal and stomach cancer affects the results of treatment. Prehabilitation includes measures to improve nutritional status and physical fitness, which are among the recommended therapies prior to surgery and are carried out as standard at our clinic and form part of your care. Our focus here is to learn more about the role that pre-treatment plays in the therapy results, quality of life and, above all, body composition (body weight, strength, mobility).

interventions.name: Patients with pancreatic, oesophageal and gastric cancer who undergo a series of established standard prehabilitation measures prior to curative resection

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Clinical UICC (Union internationale contre le cancer) stage I-III at time of diagnosis (Pancreatic cancer, esophageal cancer, gastric cancer)
- Scheduled for curative-intent therapy
- Age > 18 years and capable of signing informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
- Clinical UICC stage IV
